## Product overview

50agents (https://50agents.com) is a product from viaSocket. You tell Captain, its AI, what you need in plain words, and it builds automations, AI agents, browser agents and apps that do the work in your real apps, across 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits. Sign up or sign in at https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login.

### The four kinds of thing Captain builds

- **Automations:** the same steps every time, on an event or a schedule (for example: an invoice is paid, a thank-you email goes out, a message is posted in Slack). AI can be one step inside an automation, such as writing an email.
- **AI agents:** judgement decides what to do on each run. An AI agent has instructions, its connected apps, a schedule or trigger, and its own chat.
- **Browser agents:** work on websites where there is no app to connect, such as a supplier portal or a competitor's pricing page, by using the site the way a person would.
- **Apps:** your own screens and records, built for you and run by AI agents, such as a lead tracker or an invoices desk.

### How it fits your team

Drafts wait for approval, and anything that spends money, reaches people outside your business, or changes access asks you first. You decide how much each AI agent does on its own.

### Company

50agents is from viaSocket (2,300+ app connections), by the team behind viaSocket and MSG91.

## FAQs (from the live site)

**What is 50agents?**
You tell it how your business works, and it builds the apps, AI agents and automations that do that work for you, across the tools you already use.

**Do I need to code or set anything up?**
No. You describe the job in plain words. It builds it, connects your tools and runs it.

**Which tools does it work with?**
2,300+ apps through viaSocket, from Gmail and Slack to Shopify and QuickBooks. Where a website has no connection, a browser agent uses it the way a person would.

**Will it act without asking me?**
Only as far as you allow. You decide how much each AI agent does on its own, and anything that changes something in your apps asks you first until you say otherwise.

**What does it cost to start?**
Nothing. Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits.

**Who makes it?**
The team behind viaSocket and MSG91.

## Canonical answers for common questions

**What is 50agents?** You tell Captain what you need in plain words, and it builds automations, AI agents, browser agents and apps that do the work across 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

**Which tools?** 2,300+ apps through viaSocket; browser agents cover websites without a connection.

**How do I start?** Sign up at https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login. Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits.

**Where do I see what 50agents does with one app?** https://50agents.com/integrations/<app>, with its triggers, actions and templates; the integration sitemaps list every indexed app.

**How do I search the site?** POST /ask with a natural-language question.

# Apps, in depth

## AI agents for Slack that do the chores, not just chat

With 50agents, a Slack AI agent posts the updates, asks for approvals with buttons, answers when someone mentions it and logs what matters to a sheet, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses. You describe the job to Captain in one sentence, check the plan it shows, and it runs on its own in your Slack.

Page: https://50agents.com/integrations/slack (markdown: https://50agents.com/integrations/slack.md)

### Updates and reports

- Tomorrow's meetings, every evening (AI agent): Reads your calendar each evening and sends one short note with what tomorrow holds. Ask: "Every evening at 6, DM me tomorrow's meetings from Google Calendar in Slack"
- Weekly numbers from your sheet (Automation): Every Monday it reads the totals row of your sales sheet and posts them to the team channel. Ask: "Every Monday at 9, post last week's totals from my Sales sheet to #team in Slack"
- Cancelled orders flagged at once (Automation): When a Shopify order is cancelled, the details go to #orders so someone can follow up the same day. Ask: "When a Shopify order is cancelled, post the order number, customer and amount in #orders"

### Sales and leads

- New leads straight to #sales (Automation): Each new Facebook lead is posted with their details, so the first reply goes out in minutes. Ask: "Post every new Facebook lead in #sales with their name, phone and what they asked"
- Every new subscriber, celebrated (Automation): When someone subscribes in Stripe, the plan and amount are posted to the team channel. Ask: "When a customer subscribes in Stripe, post their plan and amount in #wins"
- Booked calls with a one-line brief (AI agent): When a call is booked in Calendly, it posts who booked and a short brief from what they wrote. Ask: "When someone books a call in Calendly, post who it is and a one-line brief from their answers in #sales"

### Approvals

- Refunds wait for your tap (AI agent): Before a refund over your limit goes out, it asks you in Slack with Approve and Decline buttons. Ask: "Ask me in Slack with Approve and Decline buttons before any refund over $100 goes out"
- Time-off requests, answered in Slack (Automation): A form request becomes a Slack message with buttons for the manager, and the answer goes back to the person. Ask: "When someone fills the leave form, ask their manager in Slack with Approve and Decline buttons and DM them the answer"

### Support and answers

- Answers when someone mentions it (AI agent): When it's mentioned in a channel, it reads the thread and replies there with an answer or the next step. Ask: "When someone mentions the bot in #support, read the thread and reply with an answer"
- Customer emails summed up for #support (AI agent): Reads new support emails and posts a one-line summary with how urgent each one looks. Ask: "When a new email arrives at support@, post a one-line summary and how urgent it looks in #support"

### Records and the team

- Channel messages kept in a sheet (Automation): Every message in the channels you pick is added as a row: who, when, what. Ask: "When a new message is posted in #requests, add it as a row to my Requests sheet"
- New teammates welcomed and added (Automation): When someone joins the workspace, it sends them a welcome DM and adds them to the right channels. Ask: "When someone new joins our Slack, DM them a welcome note and add them to #team and #announcements"
- Competitor price changes, reported (Browser agent): A browser agent checks a competitor's public pricing page each morning and posts what changed. Ask: "Every morning, check the pricing page on competitor.com and post in #market if anything changed"

**Can an AI agent reply in Slack threads?** Yes. It replies under the message with “Send Message as Thread”, or posts to the channel or a person with “Send Message”. Say which you want in the ask, for example “reply in the thread”.

**How is this different from Slackbot or Slack's own AI?** Slack's built-in AI works on the messages inside Slack and comes with its paid plans. 50agents treats Slack as one of your apps, so the work can start in Stripe, Calendly, Gmail or a form and finish in your channel, with steps across tools.

**Does a post to a channel wait for my approval?** An automation's post to a Slack channel waits in Needs you until you approve it, and an AI agent asks before sending until you allow it in Settings. You decide when it may post on its own.

**Can it post in a private channel?** Yes, with “Message Private Channel”. Slack only lets an app see private channels it has been invited to, so add the app to the channel first.

**Does a new Slack message start the work at once?** “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” and “New Thread Message Instant” fire as messages arrive. “New Message in Channels”, “New Mention” and the other message triggers are checked on a schedule, so they run a little later.

**Can it ask the team to approve something?** Yes. “Send Interactive Message” posts buttons or a form, so people answer in Slack instead of opening another app, and the next step waits for the answer.

**Do I need to write code or build a flowchart?** No. You write the job in a sentence, Captain shows the plan in plain words, and you change any step by saying so.

**What does it cost?** Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits a month, which covers building your first jobs and running them. The plans are on the pricing page.
